from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyNetIncome(BaseModel):
    """Net income figures from one company's quarterly report, enabling year-over-year comparison."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    current_period_label: str | None = Field(description="The period description for the current quarter (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2025')")
    current_period_year: str | None = Field(description="The year of the current period, extracted")
    current_net_income: float | None = Field(description="Net income amount for current period; positive for income, negative for loss")
    current_net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    prior_period_label: str | None = Field(description="The period description for the prior year quarter (e.g., 'same period in 2024')")
    prior_period_year: str | None = Field(description="The year of the prior period, extracted")
    prior_net_income: float | None = Field(description="Net income amount for prior period; positive for income, negative for loss")
    prior_net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the net income information")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_net_incomes: list[CompanyNetIncome]
